title: Paris World's Fair, the film L'Alibi and Bobby Martin's band
summary: Martin's band played the Exposition pavilion and a cabaret scene in an Erich von Stroheim film, with personnel including the McRae family member Bob McRae.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. He came here for a while. So he came over to bring the musicians over to the World's Fair in Paris. So that was the thing. We were supposed to work in the Bronx(?), and... What the hell was the name of that place? Anyway, we played at the (?) Pavilion at the World's Fair. We also made a movie with Erich Von Stroheim.
He was a famous producer, wasn't he.
Didn't he do The Blue Angel or something like that?
I think so. Something like that. We did something...a cabaret scene in the movie. I play at the introduction of the movie.
Who was in that band? We may as well put their names on here. Bobby Martin's band.
Oh, Johnny Russell, myself, Glyn Paque, me, Bob McRae and Kaiser Marshall.
Was Bob McRae related to the McRae family?
Yeah, Teddy McRae, that's right. He played tenor with Chick.
And Bobby played bass, didn't he -- Bob McRae?
He played trumpet and guitar. Guitar and
Oh yeah, Bass Hill is the bass player in this band, that's right.
